scene_analysis.scene_overview: A sunny day in a park with palm trees and other vegetation surrounding a large building with a flat roof and a few windows. The ground is covered in sand and there are several tall trees in the background. There are also some people sitting on chairs near the building.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building has a cream-colored facade with stone quoins at the corners. It has three stories and a flat roof. There are two windows on the top floor and four on the bottom floor. There are also two windows on the side of the building.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is made of sand and has tire tracks all over it. There are also some palm trees and other vegetation growing around the area.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables scattered throughout the area. Some of them have umbrellas attached to them.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several palm trees and other plants growing in the area. There are also some bushes and flowers.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the sidewalk, including a red sign with white lettering.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are a few people walking through the area, but it's not crowded.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area is quiet and peaceful, with only a few people enjoying the scenery.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: There are several shops and cafes in the area, as well as a few restaurants.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is clean and well-maintained, with plenty of space to study or work.
